attributes.board_name: South Carolina Board of Examiners in Psychology (LLR)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Minimum 12 Category A credits (regionally accredited institutions, APA-approved internship programs, APA and APA-approved sponsors, state/regional psychological associations, first-time graduate teaching, sponsors approved by other national professional organizations, refereed publishing); max 12 Category B (peer review/supervision, consultation, non-refereed publishing, meetings, journal reading and self-study)
rules.audit_note: Board requests documentation from a random sample of licensees.
rules.notes: Biennial renewal on a date determined by the Board; CE reported on the Board form at renewal. No mandatory topic hours in the regulation.
rules.legal_basis: S.C. Code Ann. Regs. 100-10; S.C. Code §40-55-85
